Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction.
The attached full-scene concept is the user's APPROVED art target for an existing 640x360 orthographic 2D pixel-art game. Produce its separate opaque ENVIRONMENT BACKDROP LAYER so all gameplay props can be rendered as independent sprites.

Keep the exact full-frame rectangular room, fixed elevated top-down camera, dimensions/proportions, perimeter wall positions, stone pattern/material, cool moonlighting, carved wall depth, moss joints, restrained highlights, bottom-right pot/fallen column decoration OUTSIDE the walking floor. Preserve the approved refined pixel-art finish. Match the input framing exactly, 16:9.

REMOVE every freestanding/gameplay object and any associated cast/contact shadow, leaving a continuous undamaged blue slate stone floor under them: remove the seedling bed upper left; the three sun/moon receiver plaques; the tall central plinth/statue; small practice column and its round pedestal at lower left; tiny practice moon slab; both diagonal silver/brass mirrors and feet; central triangle prism/pedestal; and the broad right altar with its ring. Also REMOVE the door leaf and door frame as these are a separate sprite: retain an empty dark rectangular recess in the north wall exactly where the upper-right door was. Remove the small beacon stone in its smaller north-wall niche, leaving the empty dark stone niche. Keep the wall structure around these two openings exactly aligned.

Technical world frame mapped from input to native 640x360: floor inside x24..616,y80..310, top wall y0..80, lower wall y310..360, sides x0..24/x616..640. West buttress x24..88,y80..176 is a SOLID masonry pier with shallow relief only, not an opening, recess people can enter or staircase. Keep the floor in the walking band flat and clear. No remaining silhouettes, ghost props, shadows of removed objects, beams, conduits or glyphs. Keep the top wall simple under the HUD. Do not alter the layout or add anything. Fine stone self-shading and crevice occlusion belong to the backdrop; floor lighting must stay subdued enough for the runtime lantern and beams. No text, characters, HUD, UI or borders. Output one finished opaque background layer, same framing as the input.

Use case: background-extraction.
Extract a MODULAR GAMEPLAY PROP LAYER from the approved concept attached, on a genuinely transparent alpha background. This is a single scene-aligned sprite extraction sheet, not a new layout.

Keep these objects EXACTLY in their original input locations, scale, orientation and pixel-art appearance: upper-right closed stone door AND its frame; the thin vertical beacon/inscription stele just to its left (stele only, no surrounding wall niche); northwest rectangular open seedling bed with its frame, interior and seedlings; all three sun/moon plaques; tall central broad stone plinth/statue with its round base; the small practice column WITH its round pedestal; tiny practice moon slab; both diagonally tilted slim silver mirrors with their thin brass trims and brass support feet; triangular splitter/prism and its small base; and wide right stone altar including the brass oval ring on its face. Mirrors MUST remain free-standing with no rectangular stone surround or black backing. Keep solid dark interior surfaces of the seedling bed as part of the object, not holes.

Remove the entire environment: all floor, walls, wall niches, masonry columns, sky, pot, fallen column, rubble, moss outside the props, and any floor cast/contact shadows. Every gap BETWEEN or THROUGH the mirror support feet and around their silver faces must be real transparency. Keep only self-shading inside the object silhouettes; no halos. Do not modify, enlarge, rearrange, beautify or recenter any object. In particular maintain image proportions and exact original per-object bounding positions so each can be cropped by the game's fixed coordinates. Preserve all fine carved stone and brass/silver material detail from the input. No text, labels, grid lines, drop-shadow cards, characters, checkered pattern or opaque background. Keep the full original 16:9 canvas with the extracted objects at their original positions. Genuine transparent PNG output.

Use case: identity-preserve / production game sprite state sheet.
Image 1 is the approved new STONE PLINTH identity, edited target. Image 2 is an old asset contact sheet supplied ONLY for the statue-notch-0..3 orientation definitions. Use only those four statue poses from its fourth row as geometry guidance; ignore all its other assets and old rendering quality.

Create one SQUARE transparent PNG sprite-state sheet, exactly 2 columns × 2 rows with FOUR equal cells and generous empty margins. One isolated object per cell, centered with identical ground baseline and identical round base size. Row-major states: top-left STATE 0 = the approved broad square front face; top-right STATE 1 = a VERY NARROW edge-on vertical stone slab; bottom-left STATE 2 = broad face rotated a quarter-turn to the left showing its left-directed side; bottom-right STATE 3 = VERY NARROW edge-on slab tilted/facing the opposite right direction to state 1. All four are the SAME rotating rectangular stone plinth on the SAME low round brass-rimmed pedestal. The base remains the same width in every state. Broad faces in 0 and 2, narrow edge faces in 1 and 3 are critical puzzle clues. Never turn this into a human statue, pillar head, sculpture or obelisk.

Preserve image 1's weathered blue slate, broad coherent mineral planes, beveled carved borders, chipped corners, sparse seam moss, small worn brass details and cool upper-left moonlight self-shading. Strong dimensional planes but restrained pixel texture. Match its proportions and silhouette closely, with no added parts. Crisp refined pixel clusters, no smooth antialiasing, no dithering. No floor, backdrop, cast shadow, glow, UI, labels, text, diagrams or duplicate extra objects. Genuine transparent alpha in all four cell exteriors. This sheet will be sliced and normalized into 64x88 sprites at bottom-centre anchors; readability and matching base matter more than tiny noise.

Use case: identity-preserve / production game sprite state sheet.
Images 1 and 2 are the approved slim freestanding mirror identity, the edit targets. Image 3 is an OLD contact sheet supplied ONLY to define mirror_0,mirror_1,mirror_2,mirror_3 orientations, not their stone backing (the user explicitly rejected that backing).

Create one SQUARE transparent PNG sheet exactly 2 columns × 2 rows, four equal cells, generous margins. One isolated mirror in each cell, centered, common overall height and ground baseline, with all support feet fully visible.
Row-major: top-left mirror_0 = reflective silver blade sloping UP TO THE RIGHT (/); top-right mirror_1 = reflective silver blade sloping DOWN TO THE RIGHT (\); bottom-left mirror_2 = reflective silver blade HORIZONTAL (—); bottom-right mirror_3 = reflective silver blade VERTICAL (|). No wall, floor, shadows, scenery, labels, text, glow, UI or other props. Crisp meticulous pixel-art materials; no blur, anti-aliasing or dithering. This family will become 36x48 native sprites; clean silhouettes and recognizable state directions are essential. Do not swap or duplicate the four directions.
